The '''VCA Droid Line Caster''' was a cable delivery system manufactured by [[Jabriel]]. The VCA Droid Line Caster was capable of launching fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]] or [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] cable attached to a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]], and was used in conjunction with a powerful and compact winch capable of speedily lifting several hundred [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="CFTD" />
